reading: The sketch recreates a design-tool editor screen: a dark top toolbar, a left LAYERS panel, a central white artboard labelled "Desktop" containing a hero gradient tile with a purple "Noor" badge, a selected black pill button (180x48) with its blue dimension badge and selection handles, and a grey skeleton text bar, plus a right-hand property inspector panel with FRAME/CORNER RADIUS/FILL/STROKE/EFFECTS sections. A run-wide note sets the overall page background, type and text colour.
